name: 伊奥
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3232
who: Io, a human legend who has looked twenty-three ever since he took the name, once the ferryman of the hanging city, a lean, lively young man: about 174 cm, wiry and light on his feet, a rope-climber's shoulders. Short curly hair of bright orange-red with one lock always sticking up over the forehead, olive-green eyes, a pair of small dimples that show on both cheeks when he laughs. A big old burn scar over the back of his right hand and forearm, shiny and never healed, never worse (on the viewer's left when they face us). Three loops of hemp rope always coiled round his waist. On his back a staff topped with a torch whose flame never goes out, and folded square over his back a thunder-striped leopard-king pelt, tiny blue sparks crawling in its folds after dark. A jokey, warm, easy air that has gone quieter since his uncle died: he checks whether the fire is enough first, then whether people are afraid.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young man's open, friendly face, NOT angular: bright olive-green, softly slanted eyes with a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line; light orange-red eyebrows; a scatter of faint freckles; small dimples in both cheeks when he smiles; a small straight nose; a relaxed mouth with a quick easy grin, ordinary teeth. Young, unlined skin; the eyes alone look older than the face.
palette: torch orange and ember red, leopard-pelt dun brown with electric blue sparks, olive green, hemp rope beige, soot grey
casual: His everyday wear on the walls and roads of the age of the floating towers: a plain grey wool coat of the standard issue, thinned at the elbows and scorched at the cuffs, over a sleeveless brown canvas vest and a worn linen shirt with the right sleeve rolled to show the old burn scar, patched brown trousers, soft old boots; three loops of hemp rope round the waist; the torch staff slung across his back with its flame burning, and the folded thunder-striped leopard pelt on top of it. He leans on one leg with a quick grin and the dimples showing.
private: Resting at a sentry camp fire: no staff and no pelt, a loose undyed linen shirt with the collar open and the sleeves pushed up, a sleeveless wool vest, rolled trousers, bare feet in worn soft shoes, the rope coiled and hung on a peg beside him. He is feeding one stick to a small fire with his burned hand, a crooked friendly smile.
battle: Climbing to a rescue on the hanging ropes: the grey wool coat belted tight with the three loops of hemp rope, leather gloves, leather bracers over the sleeves, boots with rope-wrapped soles, the folded leopard pelt strapped tight over his back with blue sparks in its folds. In his right hand he grips the staff with its flame burning bright and held forward, a coil of rope over his left shoulder; braced and fierce, the brows drawn together, the mouth set.
battle_pose: 3) the rescue outfit: braced and fierce, the shoulders squared, the feet planted wide, the brows drawn together and the mouth set, one hand gripping the burning torch staff held forward and a coil of rope on the other shoulder; not smiling in this one.
formal: At a night watch ceremony of the tower camp: his best grey wool coat brushed clean and worn with a folded low collar, a white linen shirt, a dark red ribbon at the throat, polished boots, the three loops of rope neatly coiled at the waist, the torch staff held upright beside him with its flame burning steady, the folded leopard pelt on his back with a few blue sparks in its folds. He stands straight, a calm grown-up half-smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the olive-green eyes looking straight at the viewer with a warm, steady, knowing look and a small smile with the dimples showing. The torch flame burning beside his cheek lights the orange-red curls and the freckles from one side in warm orange, while faint blue electric light plays on the leopard pelt behind his shoulder. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a loop of hemp rope.

name: 乌尔德·缪恩米洛
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3344
who: Wulde Muenmilo, a human star-watcher and the founding queen of the Mirror Lake realm, a legend who has looked forty-two ever since the year she took the name: tall, about 172 cm, thin, her shoulders curved slightly forward from a lifetime of looking up at the sky and bending over the page. Long straight black hair with one pale streak running from the left temple down to the ends, left undyed, usually tied back at the nape. Grey eyes, the grey of the sky just before dawn. All ten fingertips stained with ink that never washes off. A deep-blue long robe with cuffs rubbed shiny, and a small brass astrolabe hanging at her belt. A still, exact, sparing air: everything she says has been calculated.
face: FACE, as in the references: a long, composed, intelligent face of a woman of about forty: narrow grey eyes with a fine upper lash line and a faint line under each; straight dark eyebrows; a high straight nose; a thin mouth closed in a calm, level line; a few light lines at the corners of the eyes, a clear unpainted complexion; the pale streak framing the left side of her face.
build: 172 cm, tall and thin, narrow shoulders curved a little forward, a slender waist and long limbs, a small bust; a scholar's lean build.
palette: deep star-blue and ink black, dawn grey, polished brass, a streak of pale silver-white
casual: Her daily wear in the age of the floating towers: a deep-blue wool long robe that closes down the front with buttons and has fitted sleeves with cuffs rubbed shiny at the edges, a plain grey linen collar, a leather belt with a small brass astrolabe hanging from it on a short chain, sensible dark shoes; ink on all ten fingers. In one hand a rolled star chart tied with a cord; she stands slightly stooped with a level, thoughtful look.
private: Late at night over her desk: a loose, long-sleeved undyed wool house dress to the ankles with a high collar, a grey knitted shawl, soft slippers, the hair let down over one shoulder with the pale streak showing. She is writing figures in a book with an ink-stained pen by a single lamp, absorbed.
battle: Standing at the head of a camp during a relief march: the deep-blue robe shortened and belted over dark wool trousers and leather riding boots, a hooded dark cloak, leather gloves with the fingertips cut open, the brass astrolabe at her belt and a long rolled star chart in a leather tube on her back. She holds out one hand flat, palm up, with a thin ring of faint light-points above it like a small map of stars, the other hand open and steady; a calm, cold, exact look. No weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the working outfit at the head of a camp: standing straight and steady, the feet planted, the face calm and exact, one hand held out flat with a faint ring of small star-points hovering above it and the other hand holding the rolled star chart; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the founding of the lake realm: a long deep-blue velvet coat-gown open at the front over a pale underrobe, long fitted sleeves, a silver sash worked with a band of tiny stars that shift slowly, a slim silver circlet with seven small points set in the dark hair, the pale streak left showing, the brass astrolabe on its chain at the belt. Seven faint points of light hover around the circlet. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a grave and composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly upward, the grey eyes looking at the viewer with a quiet, exact look, a closed calm mouth. Cool blue-grey light from the side as at the hour before dawn, a few pale stars visible in the air behind her; ink-stained fingertips holding the brass astrolabe up near her chin. Foreground blur: the edge of a star chart and a scatter of tiny points of light. She wears the deep-blue robe with the shiny cuffs.

name: 诗蔻蒂·罗森戴尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3399
who: Sekody Rosendale, a human swordmaster and the founding queen of the Rose realm, a legend who has looked thirty-five ever since the year she took the name: short, about 158 cm, a slim waist and long legs, standing like a flower stem that looks soft and will not bend. Long deep-russet hair, the colour of dried roses, braided into one thick braid with a ring of thorny rose canes woven through it, the flowers on the canes never wilting. Honey-coloured eyes that curve down at the corners when she smiles. Her hands are covered with small pale scars from rose thorns. A slim long sword at her waist. A warm, quick-tempered, generous, laughing air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strikingly beautiful, bright face: large, softly slanted honey-amber eyes that curve downward when she laughs, with a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line and a fine eyelid crease; arched russet eyebrows; a small straight nose; a wide mouth with a generous open smile, ordinary teeth; a clear, warm complexion.
build: 158 cm, slim and long-legged: narrow shoulders but a strong straight back, a narrow waist, gently rounded hips, a modest bust; she stands like a flower stem.
palette: dried-rose russet and deep red, honey amber, thorn green, cream, pale pink petals
casual: Her wear in the Rose Valley: a fitted deep-rose wool bodice-jacket that closes down the front with buttons, over a cream linen blouse with full sleeves, a knee-length green skirt split for walking over leather riding trousers, soft brown boots; the long russet braid with its ring of thorny rose canes and ever-fresh blooms hanging over one shoulder; a slim long sword in a plain scabbard at the left of her belt. She stands with a hand on the pommel and a bright open smile, the small thorn scars showing on her hands.
private: At home in the valley between the flower beds: a long-sleeved, high-collared cream linen dress to the shins with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a green apron with a pair of small garden shears in the pocket, soft shoes, the braid over her shoulder. She is holding a freshly cut rose, laughing, thorn scars on her hands.
battle: Dancing the blade at the mouth of the valley: a close-fitted deep-rose leather jerkin over a cream blouse with the sleeves bound at the wrists, riding trousers and tall leather boots, leather bracers, the thorn-braid pinned up. She draws the slim long sword in her right hand and swings it in a wide arc, and a storm of red rose petals lifts off the blooms around her and spirals along the blade; a fierce, bright, confident look.
formal: At her crowning as queen of the roses: a long gown of deep rose-red velvet with long fitted sleeves and a high neckline, a green silk sash, a slim gold coronet of woven rose canes on the head, the braid with its thorny roses worn down the front, the slim sword carried point-down in both hands. She stands upright with a happy but dignified smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey eyes looking at the viewer with a laughing, warm look and a wide smile. Low golden evening light from one side lights the russet hair and the braided thorny roses. Foreground blur: a cloud of drifting red petals. Her scarred hand rises into the frame holding the slim sword's guard. She wears the deep-rose jacket.

name: 塔妮丝
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3509
who: Tanis, a demon-kind archer of the old arrow-god's clan, a legend who looks thirty-something: tall, about 178 cm, lean, with wide shoulders and back, her bow arm visibly thicker than the other. Deep brown skin, like wood seasoned in the sun. A pair of slim horns sweeping back from the forehead, the tips worn smooth and shiny (both horns intact). Straight hair cut to ear length, the rest of it long ago cut off and twisted into her bowstring. Pale gold eyes that do not squint at long distances. On her back a long bow made of bone, blue-white and heavier than iron. Quiet, steady, patient, a believer who has learned to hold still.
face: FACE, as in the references: a calm, strong, angular-soft face of a woman in her thirties: pale gold, narrow, slightly slanted eyes with a thin tapering dark upper lash line, a steady far-seeing gaze; straight dark eyebrows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth; two slim horns sweeping back from the forehead; ordinary human ears, NO elf ears; smooth deep-brown skin with faint lines at the eye corners.
build: 178 cm, tall and lean: broad shoulders and a strong back, the bow arm clearly thicker, a firm bust, a narrow waist and long strong legs.
palette: bone blue-white, deep wood brown, pale gold, dark ash grey, a little dull red
casual: Her daily wear in the arrow clan's camp: a sleeveless dark grey leather jerkin that closes down the front with toggles over a long-sleeved, close-fitting charcoal wool shirt, a leather bracer on the left forearm and a leather shooting glove on the right hand, dark trousers and soft knee-high boots; an arrow quiver at her right hip. On her back the blue-white bone bow strung with a string of twisted hair. She stands tall and still, looking out into the distance.
private: Resting at a camp fire: no bow on her back, a loose long-sleeved dark grey wool tunic with the collar open and sleeves rolled to the elbows over plain trousers and soft boots, the bow leaned against a rock beside her. She is waxing a bowstring slowly with her fingers, a quiet, peaceful look.
battle: Drawing the great bow on a ridge at night: the dark grey leather jerkin laced tight with a high collar, bracer and glove, a short dark cloak pinned at the left shoulder blowing in the wind, quiver on the hip. She holds the blue-white bone bow at full draw with the arrow nocked, the string at her cheek, one eye open and unwavering, the shoulders square and the feet planted wide; completely still and calm.
formal: At the arrow clan's gathering before the god's altar: a long dark ash-grey wool coat that closes down the front with buttons and has fitted sleeves, a narrow band of dull red embroidery at the collar and cuffs, the bone bow held upright in front of her in both hands, the ear-length hair neatly combed. She stands very straight, a reverent, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face in near profile then turned to the viewer, the pale gold eyes looking at the viewer with a still, patient, faintly sad look. Cold pale light from one side catches the smooth worn horn tips and the blue-white bone of the bow beside her cheek. Foreground blur: a bowstring of twisted hair drawn tight across the frame and drifting ash. She wears the dark grey jerkin.

name: 海蒂
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3674
who: Heidi, a human legend of the South Seven wall, a woman who has looked forty-eight ever since the year she took the name: medium height, about 164 cm, sturdy and strong, one shoulder higher than the other from decades of carrying stone. Sand-gold hair cut at the ears and always dusted with mortar. Cheeks reddened by wall-top wind, amber eyes with a fan of fine lines at the corners, and when she smiles one front tooth has a small chipped corner (the upper left one, on the viewer's right when they face us). The knuckles of her right hand are flattened from tapping a sword spine (on the viewer's left when they face us). At her belt a long sword of dull red-gold mountain-bronze, a row of small dents along the spine. A stubborn, sharp-minded, tender, singing air, with a voice that is not pretty.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered, kind, determined face of a woman of about forty-eight: amber, slightly slanted eyes with a fan of crow's-feet at the corners, thin sand-gold eyebrows; a short straight nose with wind-reddened cheeks; a wide mouth that smiles with teeth showing, one front tooth with a small chipped corner (the upper left one, on the viewer's right when they face us); a few faint lines by the mouth and across the forehead; a strong chin. When she grins, one of the two big upper front teeth (the upper left one, on the viewer's right when she faces us) has a clearly visible small chipped corner, a notch missing from its biting edge; draw this chipped tooth in every smiling panel, in the portrait and in every open-mouthed expression.
build: 164 cm, sturdy and solid: broad strong shoulders (the right one a little higher), strong thick arms, a full bust, a thick waist and broad hips, a stocky builder's body.
palette: sand gold, mortar grey and dust white, wind-red cheeks, dull red-gold bronze, worn brown leather
casual: Her daily wear on the South Seven wall: a patched grey wool coat of the standard issue with the elbows thinned and the cuffs scorched, a leather work apron over it and a thick canvas shirt underneath, sturdy trousers tucked into worn boots, grey mortar dust on the sleeves and knees; at her belt the long dull red-gold mountain-bronze sword with its row of small dents along the spine, the hand with the flattened knuckles resting on it. A wide grin with the chipped tooth showing.
private: Resting beneath the wall at dusk: no coat, a loose long-sleeved undyed linen shirt with the sleeves pushed up and a knitted wool vest, plain trousers, soft shoes, the sword leaned beside her. She is tapping the beat of a song on a stone with her flat knuckles and singing, the head tipped back, the eyes closed, mortar dust in her hair.
battle: Holding the breach at the mouth of the wall: the grey wool coat belted tight over a boiled-leather cuirass and iron-studded shoulder plates cut with faint rune seams, leather gauntlets, heavy boots, a dented round shield on the left arm. The long mountain-bronze sword is drawn in her right hand, its blade glowing dull gold along the edge; planted wide, shouting a verse of her song with the mouth open, a fierce stubborn look.
formal: At the naming of the seventh dawn: her one good coat, a clean grey wool coat brushed and belted, folded open at the neck over a white linen shirt, a neat band of sand-gold thread at the cuffs, boots polished, the long mountain-bronze sword hung at her side with fine rune lines glinting along the scabbard, her hair freshly cut and combed. She stands straight with her hands clasped in front and a shy, closed-mouth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face lifted a little, the amber eyes looking at the viewer with a stubborn, tender look, a wide singing smile with the chipped tooth showing. Late warm sun from behind and one side catches the sand-gold hair full of mortar dust. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and the dull gold of a sword hilt. She wears the patched grey coat.

name: 博杜安·默韦
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3728
who: Baudouin Mervay, a human admiral of the first Salt Sea fleet, fifty-nine in the year of his last voyage: tall, about 184 cm, lean and straight-backed. Silver-white hair tied in a tail at the back of his head, pale green eyes. He is missing two fingers of his left hand, taken by a sea-beast's rope when he was young (on the viewer's right when they face us). A deep-blue fleet coat washed pale with every button in place, and boots polished every day. A slow-spoken, patient, exact air; he never raises his voice on deck. The left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has only three digits: the thumb, index and middle finger; the ring and little fingers are gone at the knuckle, and this shows plainly wherever that hand is seen (lying flat on the page, gripping the flag staff), while in the dress uniform the two empty fingers of the left glove are folded flat against the palm.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, composed, weathered face of a man of fifty-nine: pale green, calm, slightly slanted eyes with fine lines at the corners, silver-white eyebrows; a long straight nose; a firm closed mouth with deep lines on either side; fair, weathered skin; a clean-shaven jaw. The irises are a clear pale sea-green, the same green in every panel and expression, never grey or blue.
build: 184 cm, tall, lean and straight-backed, narrow shoulders and a long stride.
palette: deep fleet blue washed pale, silver white, pale sea green, polished brass buttons, salt-white
casual: His daily wear at the quay: the deep-blue fleet coat, washed to a pale blue at the seams, double-breasted with every brass button in place, over a white linen shirt and a plain dark neck-cloth, dark trousers, boots polished to a shine; the silver-white tail tied back; the left hand with two fingers missing resting behind his back. He stands straight with a calm, level look.
private: Writing letters at his cabin table by lamplight: no coat, a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled and a grey knitted waistcoat, soft shoes, the silver hair loose over the collar. He holds a pen in his right hand over a half-written letter, the left hand flat on the page, drawn large: this hand has only THREE digits, a thumb, an index finger and a middle finger, and after the middle finger nothing but a smooth flat edge of scarred skin; there is no ring finger and no little finger on this hand, a quiet, heavy look.
battle: On the stern of his flagship in a gale: the deep-blue fleet coat buttoned to the collar and belted, a plain steel gorget and a leather sea-cloak blowing in the wind, polished boots; in his right hand a plain straight sword held low at his side, the left hand gripping a signal flag's staff with its only three digits, thumb, index and middle finger, the outer edge of the hand a smooth scarred stump with no ring finger and no little finger, that bare edge turned toward the viewer; the signal flag is a plain pennant of one deep sea-blue with a narrow white border, NOT striped; a calm, resolute look, the eyes on the sea.
formal: At the quayside review of the fleet: the best deep-blue fleet coat brushed clean with every brass button in place and a narrow silver braid at the cuffs, a white shirt and white gloves (the left glove folded flat over the missing fingers), polished boots, a plain dress sword at his hip. He stands very upright, grave and dignified. The left glove (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has its ring and little fingers empty and folded flat into the palm, so that glove shows only a thumb and two fingers.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale green eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, weary, kind look and a closed mouth. Cold blue-green sea light from one side and the glow of a ship's lantern warm on the other cheek. Foreground blur: drifting sea mist, a rope, and a half-written letter. He wears the washed deep-blue coat.

name: 图拉克
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3743
who: Turak, a demon-kind blood-oath priest of the old arrow-god's clan, who looks about fifty: tall, about 180 cm, spare, with a deep chest from a life of shouting names. Long snow-white hair tied back at the nape with a leather cord. A pair of slim horns on the forehead, the tips filed flat as all priests of his clan do. Pale blue-green eyes with deep lines at the corners. A voice that is quiet in talk and carries across a whole river when he calls. A gentle, steady, grieving air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lined, gentle, tired face of a man of about fifty: pale blue-green, slightly slanted eyes with deep crow's-feet; white eyebrows; a straight nose; a closed, level mouth with deep lines beside it; a pair of slim horns on the forehead with the tips filed flat; ordinary human ears, NO elf ears.
build: 180 cm, tall and spare, a deep chest and a stooped neck.
palette: snow white, pale sea-green, ash grey and dun brown, a little dull red, bone
casual: His daily wear at the clan's camp: a long dun-brown wool priest's robe that closes down the front with buttons and has fitted sleeves, a narrow band of dull red thread at the collar, a leather belt with a small pouch, a string of small bone name-tokens at the chest, plain boots; he stands with open palms and a gentle, steady look.
private: Sitting with a family at their camp fire: a plain undyed wool tunic with the sleeves rolled, a grey knitted shawl, soft shoes, the white hair loose over his shoulders. He is holding out a piece of bread to a small child beside him with a warm, tired smile.
battle: Standing at the foot of the ridge before the altars: the dun-brown priest's robe with a heavy dark leather vest and bracers over it, a hooded grey cloak, strong boots. He carries no weapon: he holds out one hand to the sky and the other to the crowd and shouts a name at full voice, the mouth open, the chest high, the face lit by firelight.
battle_pose: 3) the calling outfit: standing tall and braced, the feet planted wide, one hand lifted toward the sky and the other held out to the crowd, the mouth open as he calls a name at full voice; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the altar in front of the god's ridge: a long dun-brown priest's robe with a wide ash-grey stole embroidered with a row of small bow shapes in dull red thread, the white hair freshly bound, a string of bone tokens at the chest, a plain staff in one hand. He stands very straight, grave and gentle.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale eyes looking at the viewer with a gentle, steady, grieving look and a closed mouth. Warm orange firelight from one side lights the white hair and the filed horn tips, dusk blue on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a bone name-token on a string. He wears the dun-brown priest's robe.

name: 泽韦林·劳赫
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_五_浮塔的年月.md:3757
who: Severin Rauch, a human keeper of the first tower's fire, sixty-eight: short, about 163 cm, stocky and strong, a barrel chest and thick forearms, a habit of looking down at the furnace door. White hair cropped close to the scalp. Forearms crossed with layers of old burn scars. The left little finger is missing its top half (on the viewer's right when they face us). Dark brown eyes, hooded, steady. A thick leather apron scorched at the hem, and a heavy pair of iron furnace tongs he never lets go of. A blunt, stubborn, unfussy air. The little finger of the left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is cut off at the middle joint, a short blunt stub with no fingertip, and the stub shows clearly wherever that hand is seen.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered, square, stubborn face of a man of sixty-eight: small deep-set dark brown eyes with heavy lids and deep lines, white bristly eyebrows; a broad nose; a firm closed mouth turned down at the corners; deep lines beside the mouth and across the forehead; soot in the creases of the skin; a white buzz cut.
build: 163 cm, short and stocky, a barrel chest and thick forearms, bowed shoulders from years bent over a furnace.
palette: furnace orange and soot black, scorched leather brown, ash white, dull iron grey, a little warm red
casual: His daily wear in the first tower: a thick scorched leather forge apron over a sleeveless grey wool vest and a coarse linen undershirt, the sleeves cut off at the elbow to show the burn-scarred forearms, dark wool trousers, heavy boots, a soft cloth tied at the neck. In his right hand the heavy iron furnace tongs held down at his side. He looks down at an unseen furnace door.
private: Off shift by the tower stairs: no apron, a loose undyed wool tunic with the sleeves rolled, a worn grey knitted waistcoat, soft old shoes, the iron tongs set on the floor beside him. He pours a bowl of hot water from a battered kettle for someone out of frame, a dry, tired half-smile.
battle: Feeding the last fire as the tower falls: the scorched leather apron over a thick grey wool coat, thick leather gloves to the elbow, a cloth wrapped over the nose and mouth, heavy boots. He is braced in front of the open furnace door with the iron tongs gripped in both hands, orange firelight on his face, the knees bent and the jaw set; stubborn, refusing.
battle_pose: 3) the furnace-door outfit: braced in front of an open furnace with the feet planted wide and the knees bent, the iron tongs gripped in both hands, the jaw set and the eyes narrowed against the heat; he carries no weapon.
formal: For the day the old furnace-master is named on the tower's eave: his one good grey wool coat brushed clean and belted, folded open at the neck over a clean white linen shirt, a dark red band at the sleeve, polished work boots, the leather apron folded over the left arm with a small ember glowing on a stitched sun-disc patch, the iron tongs carried upright like a staff in his right hand. He stands upright, grave and stubborn.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face looking a little downward then raised to the viewer, the dark eyes steady and stubborn, the mouth closed. Hard orange light from an open furnace door on one side, cold blue grey tower-light on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the iron tongs. He wears the scorched leather apron.
